title: Korean Jeon with Zucchini and Magical Crust
description: A unique twist on traditional Korean pancakes, using a magical crust and snappy ingredients.
instructions: Combine Magical Crust Mix, Korean Chopped Scallions, Zucchini, Snappy Corn Starch, and Korean Chili Flakes in a bowl.
Add Jeon Batter and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Heat Vegetable Oil in a pan over medium heat.
Using a ladle, pour the batter into the pan.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the edges start to curl.
Flip the jeon over and cook for another 2 minutes.
Serve hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
Season with Salt and Black Pepper to taste.
